provenance.note: Approximate photo-textured architecture, not a measured reconstruction. Crops do not add detail beyond original video. All pixel coordinates refer to named source image before resize.

bridge_red.intended_surface: Decorative inset on red bridge entrance pier
bridge_red.caveats: Clean of people; right relief is clipped by perspective frame. Soft source, baked lighting, not seamless.

bridge_ornament.intended_surface: Decorative frieze immediately below modeled ceramic crest
bridge_ornament.caveats: Decorative painted band only, not full roof silhouette. Residual perspective and soft original video detail; no people.

roof_tiles.intended_surface: Sloping tiled roof planes; repeat along eaves
roof_tiles.caveats: Small source patch, upscaled; roof shading and perspective remain; not seamless. No people.

yellow_plaster.intended_surface: Narrow yellow wall/pier material; use low repetition
yellow_plaster.caveats: Very small real plaster strip, upscaled. Baked shadow, soft, no people, not seamless.

wood.intended_surface: Dark timber posts and inset doorway panels
wood.caveats: Tiny real dark timber crop with horizontal join; upscaled, baked light, not seamless. No people.
